title: Quiche SMP2
description: Custom Tweaks for the Quiche SMP2. Hosted by AlexisTheGeek.
body:
# Disclaimer
  Before anything said, this datapack is purely for the community of AlexisTheGeek, a french youtuber that i follow. So it won't fit into every survival worlds. However you can still use it freely. 
  I mainly uploaded it because it was more practical for the community to access.
  
# Features
- **New Food Type** : Quiches _(A very french delight)_
  - 10 Recipe for them.. One is secret and can only be rarely found like notch-apples.
  - Each giving unique effects such as Resistance or Levitation !
- **A Brand New Smithing Template** : Quiche Template
  - Allowing for some fun cosmetics called "cosmequiche", such as armor trim and tool skins.
- **Loot Integration** : All new items can be found in various structures depending of their theme.
- **New Music Discs**: all of which featuring funny songs.
- **New Advancements** : to ambrace the new features and challenges.
